blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla and Philippine National Police chief Gen. Melencio Nartatez Jr. visited Banga National High School on Monday, Sept. 21, three days after a shooting inside the campus left three students dead, including the suspected gunman. Remulla and Nartatez met with school, police, and local government officials as authorities continued their investigation into the Sept. 18 shooting and reviewed security measures for students and school personnel. Remulla conveyed President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s condolences to the families of those who died and said the incident highlighted concerns over children’s exposure to harmful online content and access to […]...
